text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — svc-inference error spike in namespace inference-prod. 1500 5xxs in last 2m, new deploy detected. Tag: release/v2.14.3

maria: seeing massive pod restarts in inference-prod-svc-*. Crashloop at start with config validation error.

jake: logs show configmap merge error: 

```
kubectl -n inference-prod logs inference-prod-svc-0
ERROR: failed to parse /etc/service/config.yaml: duplicate key 'model_paths' at line 23
```

luisa: that matches our release script change — we now write a generated-configmap + user-config and a controller merged them twice. Oof.

tessa: impact? CS reported latency/timeouts for customers on dedicated instances? @customer-success any customer hit reports?

customer-success: one enterprise cluster (acct: Streamline) reported 30s tail latencies and intermittent 503s starting 00:12 UTC. They opened a ticket.

sam: HPA also reacted and started scaling to 0->10 which made flapping worse. HorizontalPodAutoscaler minReplicas set to 0 in the rollout patch (should be 2).

maria: can we pause traffic/reroute? Is there a feature-flag to disable new merge behavior?

jake: there's a hotfix flag: `FEATURE_MERGE_V2=false` in the configmap. We can apply a quick override via kubectl patch to the deployment env. Rolling restart after patch.

ops-bot: playbook snippet invoked by jake: 

```
kubectl -n inference-prod set env deploy/inference-prod-svc FEATURE_MERGE_V2=false
kubectl -n inference-prod rollout restart deploy/inference-prod-svc
```

luisa: applying now. Patching all three zones.

maria: patch applied zone-a, restarting pods. monitoring logs.

(3m later)

maria: pods are coming up clean, no duplicate-key errors. error rate down from 1500 5xx/m to ~40.

tessa: HPA still weird because minReplicas=0 caused surge. We should set minReplicas to 2 to avoid this. Can we patch HPA and stabilize?

sam: doing `kubectl -n inference-prod patch hpa inference-prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`

ops-bot: HPA patched. Scaling stabilized; new pods now respect minReplicas.

customer-success: looping back to Streamline, they confirmed degraded experience has recovered, will keep ticket open for 24h.

jake: root cause: our configmap-generation tool duplicated the user config fragment when a release label existed. Release pipeline change introduced duplicate keys.

luisa: mitigations done: disabled feature flag, patched HPA minReplicas, rolled pods. Next steps: revert generator change in release branch, add unit test for duplicate keys, and add canary check for config diffs pre-rollout.

maria: assigning follow-ups: 
- luisa: PR to revert generator (ETA 2h)
- jake: add config-diff canary step and unit-test (ETA EOD)
- sam: run a quick audit for any other namespaces using generator (ETA 1h)

incident-bot: Incident severity: P1 (customer impact). Status: mitigated (feature flag disabled, HPA patched). Incident owner: maria.

maria: handing off to night oncall @tessa for monitoring and customer comms. If Streamline sees any regression escalate back to SRE pager.

tessa: acknowledged, I'll watch for 2h and ping cs if anything degrades. :white_check_mark:

(END THREAD)
